description:
Manage Focus tasks with the following actions:

- **create-task**: Create a task with related data such as subtasks, time blocks, and an initial time entry. (data: payload*{task*, estimate_allocations, subtasks, time_blocks, time_entry})
- **archive**: Archive Tasks. (data: from_recurring_task_id, task_id*)
- **attachments-bulk-create**: Attachments Bulk Create Tasks. Uploads several local files in one call. names and display_orders are optional parallel arrays; they default to the file basenames and array positions. (data: task_id*, file_paths*, names, display_orders)
- **attachments-create**: Attachments Create Tasks. Uploads a local file (file_path) as an attachment. The mime type is inferred from the extension and the API rejects disallowed types; uploads are capped at 20 MB. (data: task_id*, file_path*, name, display_order)
- **attachments-delete**: Attachments Delete Tasks. (data: attachment_id*, task_id*)
- **attachments-list**: Attachments List Tasks. Lists attachment metadata. Upload files with attachments-create (file_path), download with attachments-view (save_to). (data: order_by, task_id*)
- **attachments-update**: Attachments Update Tasks. Full update (PUT): both name and display_order are required; the response body is empty, verify via attachments-list. (data: attachment_id*, payload*{display_order*, name*}, task_id*)
- **attachments-view**: Attachments View Tasks. Downloads the attachment's binary content to a local path (save_to). Refuses to replace an existing file unless overwrite is true. (data: task_id*, attachment_id*, save_to*, overwrite)
- **bulk-archive**: Bulk Archive Tasks. (data: task_ids*)
- **bulk-create**: Bulk Create Tasks. (data: tasks*)
- **bulk-delete**: Bulk Delete Tasks. Deletes all listed task IDs in one HTTP call. Requires confirm flow like single delete. (data: ids*, outbound_sync)
- **bulk-duplicate**: Bulk Duplicate Tasks. (data: cascade_duplicate_children*, task_ids*, private)
- **bulk-patch**: Bulk Patch Tasks. Prefer over many single updates: pass a JSON array of { id: taskId, ...partial fields }. Same field names as single task update. (data: array payload)
- **bulk-restore**: Bulk Restore Tasks. (data: task_ids*)
- **bulk-unarchive**: Bulk Unarchive Tasks. (data: task_ids*)
- **constraints-list**: Constraints List Tasks. (data: none)
- **constraints-upsert**: Constraints Upsert Tasks. (data: payload*{enabled*, required_fields*})
- **create**: Create Tasks. Required: name. Strongly recommended: project_id, status_id, assignee_user_ids. Use start_date/end_date for scheduling as date-only YYYY-MM-DD values; never pass RFC 3339 datetimes. Set estimated_mins for time estimates. (data: name*, allocation_unit, assignee_user_ids, auto_log_time, billable, color, custom_fields, description, end_date, estimate_type, estimated_mins, integration_ext_id, integration_source, notes, parent_task_id, pinned, position, priority, priority_at, private, project_id, rollup_enabled, rrule, start_date, status_id, tag_ids, team_assignee_ids)
- **delete**: Delete Tasks. Permanently deletes the task and all its subtasks. Cannot be undone. (data: task_id*)
- **estimate-allocations-create**: Estimate Allocations Create Tasks. (data: payload*, task_id*)
- **estimate-allocations-delete**: Estimate Allocations Delete Tasks. (data: id, task_id*)
- **estimate-allocations-list**: Estimate Allocations List Tasks. (data: task_id*)
- **estimate-allocations-update**: Estimate Allocations Update Tasks. (data: payload*, task_id*)
- **get**: Get Tasks. Fetch a single task with full detail including subtasks and time estimates. (data: task_id*)
- **get-by-external-id**: Get By External Id Tasks. (data: ext_id*, source*)
- **get-calendar-events**: Get Calendar Events Tasks. (data: calendar_event_id, date_from, date_to, hidden)
- **get-recurring-instances**: Get Recurring Instances Tasks. (data: archived, assignee_team_id, assignee_user_id, dates_overlap_end, dates_overlap_start, end_date, include_assignees, page, per_page, recurring_task_ids, start_date, tag_id, team_id)
- **get-stream**: Get Stream Tasks. (data: active_by_date, archived, assignee_team_id, assignee_user_id, cf_filter, client_id, dates_overlap_end, dates_overlap_start, end_date, end_date_from, end_date_to, estimated_mins_max, estimated_mins_min, has_dates, has_time_blocks, has_time_entries, include_assignees, include_drafts, include_parent_matches, include_project_completed, is_priority, name, order_by, parent_task_id, pinned, priority, private_, project_id, recurring, recurring_task_ids, source, start_date, start_date_from, start_date_to, state, status_id, tag_id, team_id, time_block_completed, time_block_id, toggl_user_id, with_entries)
- **get-with-children**: Get With Children Tasks. (data: archived, assignee_user_id, include_assignees, order_by, page, per_page, source, status_id, tag_id, task_id*, team_id)
- **get-with-parents**: Get With Parents Tasks. (data: archived, assignee_user_id, include_assignees, order_by, page, per_page, source, status_id, tag_id, task_id*, team_id)
- **groups-get**: Groups Get Tasks. (data: assignee_user_id, cf_filter, client_id, collapse_recurring, creator_id, end_date, end_date_from, end_date_to, exclude_empty, group*, group_id, include_assignees, include_drafts, include_unassigned, include_unmaterialized, min_days, name, order_by, page, per_page, priority, private_, project_id, source, start_date, start_date_from, start_date_to, status_id, tag_id, team_id, user_cf_filter, user_tag_id)
- **groups-get-user-task-groups-by-project**: Groups Get User Task Groups By Project Tasks. (data: assignee_user_id*, cf_filter*, client_id*, collapse_recurring*, creator_id*, end_date*, end_date_from*, end_date_to*, exclude_empty*, group_id*, include_assignees*, include_drafts*, include_unassigned*, include_unmaterialized*, min_days*, name*, priority*, private_*, project_id*, source*, start_date*, start_date_from*, start_date_to*, status_id*, tag_id*, team_id*, user_cf_filter*, user_tag_id*)
- **groups-get-user-task-groups-by-team**: Groups Get User Task Groups By Team Tasks. (data: assignee_user_id, cf_filter, client_id, collapse_recurring, creator_id, end_date, end_date_from, end_date_to, exclude_empty, group_id, include_assignees, include_drafts, include_unassigned, include_unmaterialized, min_days, name, priority, private_, project_id, source, start_date, start_date_from, start_date_to, status_id, tag_id, team_id, user_cf_filter, user_tag_id)
- **groups-update**: Groups Update Tasks. (data: group*, payload*)
- **list**: List Tasks. Filter by start_date/end_date (ISO 8601, e.g. '2025-04-27') for date ranges, project_id, status_id, or assignee_user_id. Returns paginated results — use page/per_page for more. Use parent_task_id to list subtasks. Priority values: none, low, medium, high. (data: name, status_id, project_id, tag_id, assignee_user_id, priority, start_date, end_date, parent_task_id, page, per_page)
- **restore**: Restore Tasks. (data: task_id*)
- **suggestions-get-project-suggestion-for-atask**: Suggestions Get Project Suggestion For Atask Tasks. (data: payload*{task_id*})
- **suggestions-get-project-suggestions-for-multiple-tasks**: Suggestions Get Project Suggestions For Multiple Tasks Tasks. (data: payload*{task_ids*})
- **unarchive**: Unarchive Tasks. (data: task_id*)
- **update**: Update Tasks. Partial update — only include fields to change in payload. Provide task_id at top level and the fields to update under payload. custom_fields writes values as a map keyed by custom field ID; reads return the same data as custom_field_values[], so the write shape is not the read shape. (data: task_id*, payload*{...})
- **full-update**: Full Update Tasks. (data: payload*{...}, task_id*)
- **update-calendar-range**: Update Calendar Range Tasks. (data: date_from*, date_to*)

Pass the action-specific fields under `data` (required fields are marked with *).
Mutations require a confirm_token handshake: call without confirm_token first to receive a token, then call again with the token to confirm.
Optional dry_run: true validates input and returns { dry_run, operation, input } without calling the API.

action.description: One of: create-task, archive, attachments-bulk-create, attachments-create, attachments-delete, attachments-list, attachments-update, attachments-view, bulk-archive, bulk-create, bulk-delete, bulk-duplicate, bulk-patch, bulk-restore, bulk-unarchive, constraints-list, constraints-upsert, create, delete, estimate-allocations-create, estimate-allocations-delete, estimate-allocations-list, estimate-allocations-update, get, get-by-external-id, get-calendar-events, get-recurring-instances, get-stream, get-with-children, get-with-parents, groups-get, groups-get-user-task-groups-by-project, groups-get-user-task-groups-by-team, groups-update, list, restore, suggestions-get-project-suggestion-for-atask, suggestions-get-project-suggestions-for-multiple-tasks, unarchive, update, full-update, update-calendar-range

confirm_token.description: Mutation confirmation token from previous call
